Digitally NARESH signed by KUMAR NARESH KAMDE KUMAR Hon'ble Shri Justice Bibhu Datta Guru KAMDE Order on Board 04/10/2024
1. No one is present on behalf of the petitioner in repeated call.

2. By the present petition the petitioner is seeking following relief :-
"10.1 That this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to call the entire record relating to the case of the petitioner.

10.2 That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to issue a writ of Mandamus directing to Respondent authority to make a reference under Sub Section 4 of section 3H of the National Highway Act 1956 and decide the application accordingly under Sub Section 4 of section 3H of the National Highway Act 1956.
Rathlal Patel vs Sub Divisional Officer Cum Land ... on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143329182/

entities.text: Rathlal Patel vs Sub Divisional Officer Cum Land ... on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Any other relief deems fit just and proper may also be passed in favour of the petitioner.
10.4 Cost of the petition may also be granted to the petitioner."

3. In this petition the petitioner is aggrieved against the action of the respondent-authorities who have not acted as per Prescribed Provision under sub section 4 of Section 3 H of the National Highway Act, 1956 regarding ownership of the land and the respondent-authorities not ready to pay amount of compensation under the award to the petitioner.
4. As no one is appearing for the petitioner, it appears that the petitioner has lost his interest in pursuing the present writ petition.
5. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed for want of prosecution.

Sd/-Sd/-
(Bibhu Datta Guru) JUDGE Kamde Rathlal Patel vs Sub Divisional Officer Cum Land ...
